scripts.dev: npm run build:core && concurrently --kill-others -n contracts,backend,frontend "tsc -b src/shared src/domain --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: tsc -b src/shared src/domain src/backend && npm run build --workspace @group9/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && tsc -p tsconfig.check.json && npm run typecheck --workspace @group9/frontend
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:core && vitest run --project unit
scripts.test:api: npm run build:core && vitest run --project api
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:core && vitest run --project integration
scripts.test:components: npm run build:core && vitest run --project components
